row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (Talk to an Expert); Kay AI agent $1 per resolved ticket
row.evidence: Kayako's help centre documents only JWT-based remote-authentication SSO and says Azure AD integration "is not something that we currently support"; no SCIM endpoint is documented, while the REST API has user create/update/delete endpoints.
row.notes: No SCIM and no SAML/OIDC: Kayako's SSO is a custom JWT remote-authentication scheme (Admin > Security > Authentication > 'Single sign-on (JWT)'), so sso_plan is null; Active Directory/Azure AD SSO is unsupported (feature request). Pricing is now quote-only: Kayako One full helpdesk via 'Talk to an Expert', plus the Kay AI agent at $1 per resolved ticket with no seat fees. Public REST API (OAuth 2.0 or Basic auth) has users, roles and teams endpoints, so customers could script provisioning, but no IdP connector uses it. Okta OIN lists Kayako as SWA (password vaulting) only. Kayako Classic is a separate legacy product, not researched. Status none by absence (medium).
